label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles I.42: For two supposed beings necessary through themselves…
interpretation: This is a positive nested causal argument, not just the earlier two-mode list. Accident classification, essence-or-external cause exhaustion, and external cause of distinctness implying dependence of proper being remain source commitments, not independently checked truths. A shared Necessary predicate does not itself establish the same essential nature or uniform production of the same accidental feature: the intrinsic branch requires an independently defended same-nature/same-essential-production warrant. No automatic mapping from an accident’s cause to an ActualConcreteGround edge is made. Based on the verified complete Pegis translation chapter; no pinned Latin reading or formal proof/premise truth is asserted.
